civilopediaText.text: Housing limits population. Fresh water +3, Aqueduct +6. Check CityScreen housing.
1 district per type per city, slots 1,4,7,10. Adjacency +0.5 per district. Place via CityScreen.
Slots Military/Economic/Diplomatic/Wildcard. Switch government clears slots free.
Walls give HP only, not strength. Siege -17 vs land, not vs city.
Loyalty 0-100, foreign pressure flips to Free City. Governor +8.
Multiplayer via Cloudflare Worker flagfish/horse: save to KV, realtime WS, push.
